expressions.title: The Preparation of Electoral Rolls (Federally Administered Tribal Areas) Order, 1975
expressions.title_basis: p1 (book p.300) prints at its head paragraphs 3-4 and the signatures of a preceding Order (free telephone and a driver-cum-gunman; its title is not in this copy), then 'THE PREPARATION OF ELECTORAL ROLLS (FEDERALLY ADMINISTERED TRIBAL AREAS) ORDER, 1975. PRESIDENT'S ORDER No. 1 OF 1975 [2nd April, 1975]' (block 2343456) and its Articles to the end of the copy; its margin notes 'Short title, extent and commencement', 'Definition', 'Preparation of electoral rolls' (blocks 2343449-2343451) are read before the page text and belong to it. The preceding Order's tail is a fragment, set aside as apparatus (owner policy q1 'split').
